decisions.reason: Although the firm knows recruitment and staffing operations well, healthcare and hospitality are outside its maritime knowledge base, so its absorptive capacity to interpret demand, build sector-specific capabilities and improve the offer is relatively weak compared with its core business.

Superyacht crew recruitment is closely related to the firm's existing maritime crewing, training and compliance capabilities, so it can readily absorb market feedback and leverage its established networks to refine and scale the service.
